heading: Duty roster
intro: Who is on duty, by day. A person is on one shift at a time. A shift is cancelled, never edited.

conflict.rest: Conflict: less than {{hours}} hours of rest

onCall.heading: On call now
onCall.error: The people on call could not be loaded.
onCall.none: Nobody is on call at the moment.

new.title: Add a shift
new.description: Put a member of staff on duty. The kind of shift fills the usual hours; change them if needed.
new.kindHint: Fills the start and end with the usual hours.
new.endHint: At or before the start means the next day. At most 24 hours.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel the shift of {{name}}?
cancelDialog.description: The shift stays in the record as cancelled and the time is free again.
cancelDialog.failed: The shift could not be cancelled. It may have changed: check the list.

errors.overlap: This person is already on duty at that time. Choose another time.
errors.onLeave: This person is on approved leave then.
errors.period: A shift ends after it starts, within a day.
errors.user: This person is not on the staff of this hospital.

leave.heading: Leave
leave.intro: Ask for days off. A second person with the right to manage the roster approves or rejects the request. Approved leave keeps you off new shifts. No reason is kept.
leave.empty: No leave requested or coming up.

new.title: Ask for leave
new.description: Choose the days you will be away. Someone else decides on the request.
new.lastHint: The day you are back at work is the one after.

errors.overlap: You already have leave requested or approved in these days.
errors.period: Leave ends after it starts, within 90 days, and has not already passed.
errors.shifts: This person still has shifts in those days. Cancel them first, then approve.
errors.own: Someone else decides on your leave.
errors.changed: The request has changed. Check the list and try again.
